zh.name: 看得见的成果与背后付出
zh.summary: 用成对照片把困难、准备或投入与可见成果联系起来，表达一项有条件的判断。
zh.useWhen: 必须解释两图关系；不把励志配图推断成确定因果。物件磨损隐喻也合并在此。
zh.instructions: 真实投入与结果、可说明关系、配对照片
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Effort and Outcome Opinion
en.summary: Create an Instagram opinion carousel using the effort and outcome opinion structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the effort and outcome opinion format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

goals: 看得见的成果与背后付出
imageCues: 每页上下连续训练/制作画面，短白色全大写句子34–44px居中
上半说出真实感受或可见困难，下半给出对目标有帮助的具体回应
可重复同一收束句形成节奏，但动作必须推进
